column1: # Stage B of the refactor program (#2062): where each item of src/widgets/file_tree.rs goes.
# One row per item, in file order. pr 0 means the item stays in file_tree.rs; the others
# move to src/widgets/file_tree/<file>.rs in that PR. kind, impl and name are as
# `scripts/move_items.py --target file_tree --check` after adding an item to file_tree.rs.
# file_tree.rs keeps FileTree, its constructor, and Node, the row its fields hold.
